description: R-CURSOR-1 fixture r-cursor-1-pct2-main2: tables with ID LONG primary key and text, filled by single-row INSERTs in ID order: P2, P3, P5, P10 with 18, 27, 45, 90 rows of one 200-character V (400 bytes, about 9 rows per page, so 2, 3, 5, 10 pages); W4 with 64 rows of two 225-character columns (900 bytes, about 4 per page); W1 with 32 rows of eight 225-character columns (3,600 bytes, one per page); IA and IB with 90 rows of a 200-character V each, inserted one row of IA then one of IB in turn, so their pages interleave. ACCDB by DBEngine.CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120) and db.Execute; the closed file is kept.
